title: Securing API Routes with Authentication
description: Protect your own endpoints using NextAuth sessions and share the user context.

slides.title: API Routes Need Love Too 🫂
Protected API Route (pages/api/protected.js)
slides.content: Returns user data only if authenticated.

quizData.question: How do you retrieve the session inside an API route?

options.text: Using `getServerSession` with the request and response objects
It's automatically injected in the request

quizData.explanation: `getServerSession(req, res, authOptions)` returns the session in server‑side contexts like API routes.

slides.title: Sharing authOptions 🧹
Example: User‑Specific To‑Do API (pages/api/todos.js)
slides.content: Fetch todos only for the authenticated user.

quizData.question: What does `session.user` typically contain?

options.text: name, email, image – standard OAuth profile fields

quizData.explanation: NextAuth populates the session with the profile data from the OAuth provider, which you can extend.
